comparison: Perfect agreement on claims C4, C20, C21, C26, C27, C28, C29 regarding positive charge sufficiency for STX17 recruitment. Both evaluations find the evidence strongly supported with no concerns raised.

Perfect agreement on claims C22, C23, C24 regarding evolutionary conservation and sequence divergence supporting electrostatic mechanism. Both evaluations find this evidence supports the charge-based rather than sequence-specific model.

Perfect agreement on claims C30, C31, C32 regarding in vitro liposome binding and electrostatic interactions. Both evaluations find the salt sensitivity and lipid-independent charge recognition well-supported.

Perfect agreement on claims C7, C53, C54, C55 regarding Sac1 phosphatase release of STX17 from isolated autophagosomes. Both evaluations find this biochemical evidence convincing, though OpenEval notes inability to deplete PI4P in vivo as a limitation.

Perfect agreement on claims C8, C56, C57, C58, C59, C60 regarding molecular dynamics simulations showing PI4P-dependent membrane insertion. Both evaluations find the computational evidence convincing with appropriate controls.

Strong agreement on claims C5, C33, C34, C35, C36, C37 regarding charge biosensor data showing increased negative charge during autophagosome maturation. Both evaluations find this evidence clear and convincing. Peer review also includes C65 in their evaluation.

Strong agreement on claims C6, C38, C39, C44, C45, C46, C47 regarding PI4P accumulation on mature autophagosomes. OpenEval finds evidence strongly supported; peer reviewers call this 'a very interesting and important discovery.' Peer review also evaluates C48-C52 together with these claims.

Agreement on claims C48, C49, C50, C51, C52 regarding knockdown/knockout experiments ruling out alternative explanations. OpenEval evaluates these separately while peer review groups them with PI4P accumulation claims (C6, C38, C39, C44-C47).

Strong agreement on claims C61, C62, C63, C91, C92 as main conceptual advances. Both evaluations affirm the electrostatic maturation model. OpenEval notes STX17 doesn't localize to all negatively charged membranes; peer reviewers emphasize this as a key conceptual advance in autophagy.

Agreement on claims C41, C42, C43, C73, C74, C75, C76, C77, C78 regarding PI4P literature and unsuccessful depletion attempts. OpenEval finds citations appropriate but notes experimental limitations. Peer review rates as UNCERTAIN due to inability to manipulate PI4P levels in cells, which is a major weakness. Peer review also includes C79.

Partial overlap on claims C70, C71, C72 regarding PI4P/PI3P levels and negative charge sources. OpenEval finds inferences reasonable with appropriate acknowledgment of speculation. Peer review rates as UNCERTAIN, noting the key question about why STX17 recruits only to mature autophagosomes was not fully answered. Peer review also includes C65, C66.

Overlap on claim C66 regarding alternative negatively charged molecules. OpenEval rates as UNCERTAIN, noting this is explicitly speculative. Peer review also rates as UNCERTAIN, emphasizing authors acknowledge they 'do not exclude the possible involvement of other negatively charged molecules.'

Overlap on claim C79 regarding speculation about unsuccessful PI4P depletion. OpenEval rates as UNCERTAIN, noting this requires further validation. Peer review also rates as UNCERTAIN, stating the authors' speculation about redundancy is not tested.

OpenEval evaluates claims C1, C2, C3, C9, C10, C11, C12, C93, C94, C95 as well-established background knowledge with appropriate citations. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these background claims.
OpenEval evaluates claims C13, C14, C15 regarding conflicting literature findings as appropriately summarized. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these literature review claims.
OpenEval evaluates claims C16, C17, C18, C19 regarding STX17TM construct justification as well-supported. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these methodological justification claims.

OpenEval evaluates claims C25, C64, C80, C81, C82, C83, C84, C85, C86, C87, C88, C89, C90 as well-established background on membrane biology with appropriate citations. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these background claims.

OpenEval evaluates claims C40, C96, C97, C98, C99, C100, C101 regarding methodological background and prior work as appropriately supported. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these methodological background claims.
